landing.title: Balcão · an AI attendant for a neighbourhood pharmacy
landing.headline: An AI attendant for a neighbourhood pharmacy.
landing.lede: Fictional. Working. With the glass box open.

does.title: What it does
does.stock: Checks stock and price, and reserves the product for pickup.
does.clinical: Knows the clinical limit and points to the store's pharmacist.
does.languages: Answers in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

business.title: For your business
business.knows: It knows what it must not say.
business.pharmacist: I was a pharmacist before I was a developer.

warning.label: Notice:
warning.text: this is a demo, and the data is fictional. Messages are kept for 7 days; “delete my data” deletes your data from Balcão.
